parameters.name: Blacklist
parameters.description:
The IP addresses that you want to manage. This parameter is a JSON string. The string contains the following fields:

*   **src**: the IP address. This field is required and must be of the STRING type.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo delete-auto-cc-blacklist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --query-type example-string --blacklist src_:_198.51.XX.XX_,_src_:_198.52.XX.XX --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
